title: Brazilian Port Calls & Lead Time 2023-2025
subtitle: Brazilian port-call data for lead-time and machine learning
description: Academic snapshot of cleaned Brazilian port-call records for EDA, regression, quantile regression, and supply chain lead-time studies. Manual port coordinates and municipality fields are excluded from the public Kaggle outputs; attribution is required for Porto Sem Papel / Ministerio de Portos e Aeroportos and Open-Meteo.
